metadata.notes: Repo-local curated GENERATE catalog entries — first-class neural architectures that ship as a Jinja2 template + composable blocks but have no markdown spec under E:/documents/algo_models. The catalogBridge merges these into the trainable catalog as runnerSource='generate' so they appear in the Train dropdown with curated hyperparameters. Each `templateId` must match a real template under src/templates/architectures and an entry in generate_model.py DEFAULT_FAMILY_FOR_CATALOG keyed by `id`.

extras.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer
extras.overview: Interpretable Temporal Fusion Transformer (Lim et al. 2019) adapted for single-shot classification over rolling feature windows. Per-timestep Variable Selection Networks pick which engineered features matter, an LSTM encodes local context, Gated Residual Networks gate information flow, and interpretable multi-head attention exposes which positions in the window drive each prediction. Streams variable-selection importance + temporal attention, a filter-normalized 3D loss surface, and verbose grad-norm / LR / throughput / VRAM diagnostics.
principles: Variable selection learns per-feature relevance instead of forcing all inputs through equally
Gated Residual Networks let the model skip unused transformations (suppress noise)
Interpretable multi-head attention shares value projections so attention is directly readable
LSTM local encoder captures short-range temporal structure before global attention
applications: Direction classification over multi-feature intraday windows
Interpretable feature attribution for which signals the model relies on
Regime-aware temporal weighting via attention maps
keyFeatures: Interpretable multi-head attention with readable attention maps

hyperparameters.name: window_size
hyperparameters.description: Length of the rolling input window in bars.

hyperparameters.name: d_model
hyperparameters.description: Hidden embedding width (must be divisible by n_heads).

hyperparameters.name: n_epochs
hyperparameters.description: Max epochs per fold (early stopping may end sooner).

hyperparameters.name: early_stop_patience
hyperparameters.description: Epochs without val-loss improvement before stopping.

hyperparameters.name: loss_surface
hyperparameters.description: Compute + emit a filter-normalized 3D loss surface after training.

hyperparameters.name: loss_surface_resolution
hyperparameters.description: Grid resolution per axis for the loss surface (cost is O(res^2)).
